name: okraPDF Self-Host Runtime
description: Static-first okraPDF runtime for Railway or Cloudflare-compatible hosting with external workflow recipes.

recipe_catalogs.description: Swappable OCR, audit, redact, and review workflows.
Optional n8n exports or webhook recipes maintained outside the core runtime.

capability_catalogs.description: Low-level runnable capability manifests bound by workflow recipes.

services.name: Okra App Shell
services.description: Public self-host shell serving static UI assets and API routes.

services.name: MinerU Parser
services.description: Optional isolated parser capability service using the okra-capability-http/v1 starter adapter. Replace the command or image with the model-backed MinerU implementation when available.

services.name: WCAG Auditor
services.description: Optional isolated audit capability service using the okra-capability-http/v1 starter adapter.

services.name: Policy Redactor
services.description: Optional isolated redaction capability service using the okra-capability-http/v1 starter adapter.

services.name: External n8n
services.description: Optional external n8n workspace that calls the webhook bridge recipes.

docker_networks.name: Edge ingress
docker_networks.description: Only public-facing HTTP ingress. Keep databases, parser containers, and external workflow runners off this network.

docker_networks.name: Core runtime
docker_networks.description: Private app-to-database lane for graph state, auth records, and runtime metadata.

docker_networks.name: Capability mesh
docker_networks.description: Private service lane for parser, audit, redaction, and model containers that the app calls through declared capability refs.

docker_networks.name: External integrations
docker_networks.description: Explicit bridge for independently launched services such as n8n. Create or attach this network intentionally; do not use host networking.

promotion_actions: Replace the starter adapter with a model-backed MinerU HTTP service image.
Build and publish the image, or point Railway/Docker at an equivalent private image.
Smoke POST /v1/capability-runs through the okra-capability-http/v1 protocol.
After the promoted service passes capability smoke, update capability-promotion.evidence.json and rerun readiness with --capability-evidence capability-promotion.evidence.json.

metadata.notes: This handoff names the target service image and model cache boundary. The checked-in command remains the starter adapter until a real model-backed image exists.

promotion_actions: Replace the starter adapter with a deterministic WCAG audit service image.
Publish versioned rule-pack metadata with the service image.
Smoke POST /v1/capability-runs through the private okra-capabilities network.
After the promoted service passes capability smoke, update capability-promotion.evidence.json and rerun readiness with --capability-evidence capability-promotion.evidence.json.

metadata.notes: Audit starts as a graph-policy adapter. The service boundary is explicit so a rule-pack or agent-backed auditor can replace it without changing app networking.

promotion_actions: Replace the starter adapter with a policy-backed redaction service image.
Publish policy-pack metadata with the service image.
Smoke POST /v1/capability-runs through the private okra-capabilities network.
After the promoted service passes capability smoke, update capability-promotion.evidence.json and rerun readiness with --capability-evidence capability-promotion.evidence.json.

metadata.notes: Redaction stays behind the capability mesh and writes graph proposals/artifacts only through the capability protocol.

env.name: OKRA_BASE_URL
env.description: Public URL for this self-host instance.

env.name: OKRA_RECIPE_CATALOG_DIR
env.description: Directory mounted or bundled with workflow recipes.

env.name: OKRA_DATA_DIR
env.description: Writable directory for uploaded PDFs, source refs, workflow runs, and OkraDocumentGraph artifacts.

env.name: OKRA_REGISTRATION_MODE
env.description: Controls whether new users can join the instance.

env.name: OKRA_FIRST_OWNER_EMAIL
env.description: Email address for the first self-host owner/admin shown in runtime status and Railway setup prompts.

env.name: OKRA_API_KEY
env.description: API key accepted by the self-host API for uploads, workflow runs, and external automation clients such as n8n.

env.name: OKRA_CAPABILITY_ENDPOINTS
env.description: Optional JSON object mapping capability refs to isolated HTTP service base URLs or full /v1/capability-runs endpoints.

env.name: OKRA_CAPABILITY_PARSER_MINERU_URL
env.description: Optional MinerU capability service base URL on the okra-capabilities network. When set, parser.mineru runs through the HTTP capability protocol instead of the starter in-process dispatcher.

env.name: OKRA_CAPABILITY_AUDITOR_WCAG_BASIC_URL
env.description: Optional WCAG audit capability service base URL on the okra-capabilities network.

env.name: OKRA_CAPABILITY_REDACTOR_POLICY_BASIC_URL
env.description: Optional policy redaction capability service base URL on the okra-capabilities network.

env.name: HF_HOME
env.description: Persistent Hugging Face cache for optional parser services.

env.name: OKRA_CAPABILITY_HTTP_PORT
env.description: Port exposed by optional HTTP capability services on the private capability network.

env.name: OKRA_N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret for optional external n8n webhook recipes.

volumes.purpose: Uploads, exports, graph artifacts, and model caches.

data_boundary.notes: The runtime stores graph state and artifacts on the filesystem in the okra-data volume; no database is required. OCR/agent orchestration stays in external recipe catalogs or bridge services. A managed Postgres can later be added as an indexed metadata store without changing graph contracts.

auth_bootstrap.notes: Railway template users set OKRA_FIRST_OWNER_EMAIL and OKRA_API_KEY during deploy. The starter runtime gates mutating routes by API key while keeping health, status, static UI, and catalogs readable for smoke checks.

metadata.note: Manifest-first scaffold. Convert to a concrete Railway template after S.5.4 license and OSS boundary decisions.
